expected_level_description: You can: - set the category management approach for the organisation - lead categories with the highest spend and risk, and align them with organisational strategy - work with other organisations on collaborative buying

You can: - set the organisation's commercial strategy for technology and cloud - lead negotiations on enterprise agreements and strategic platforms - advise digital leaders on the commercial risks of technology choices

You can: - analyse a supply market, its competition, risks, and trends - lead early market engagement, such as supplier days, without distorting competition - use market evidence to shape requirements and commercial models
You can: - lead high-value, high-risk negotiations with strategic suppliers - coach others in negotiation and set the organisation's negotiation approach

You can: - set social value and sustainability criteria that fit the contract - manage supplier commitments, such as local jobs, skills, and carbon reduction - check supply chains for risks such as forced labour and other human rights abuses

You can: - advise on the lawful route for complex procurements and contract changes - manage the risk of challenge and handle standstill and debrief correctly - write procurement policy and guidance for the organisation

You can: - take responsibility for complex relationships with contracted suppliers - identify appropriate contractual frameworks and identify appropriate suppliers - negotiate with contracted suppliers - get good value out of contracts and suppliers

You can: - develop and own a business case and iterate it throughout the life cycle - coach others on identifying benefits whilst balancing user and business needs - communicate the delivery of incremental value - build the case for an organisational approach to value through product strategy - coach and empower teams to take a value for money approach

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
